nom: RoC Derm Correxion Fill + Treat Wrinkle Filling Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to extremely dry skin report the serum comfortable from first use, no breakouts or reactions, and gradual smoothing of smile and forehead lines.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good tolerance thanks to the hyaluronic acid buffering the retinol, but one reports peeling on the forehead the morning after first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging report visible softening of forehead lines, laugh lines and crow's feet with regular use, though results are described as gradual rather than dramatic.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, smoother and plumper-looking skin around the mouth, forehead, eyes and neck, some noticing change within days; a minority see no improvement even after several weeks of consistent use, and several caution it does not touch deeper wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe increased hydration and a plumped, smoother feel after application; one reviewer notes the opposite effect, with the product rubbing off as flaking dead skin by end of day.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with reactive skin reports forehead peeling the day after a single use; most other reviewers report no redness or reaction at all.

aspects.libelle: Creamy, smooth glide with no greasy residue
Pilling or flaking under makeup by end of day
Applicator tip precise for spot treatment

Occasional skin peeling after first use
Results fade or require continued purchase to maintain

extraits.texte: I received this sample for free to try. I was very excited to try it because no one likes lines and wrinkles! I do not typically have any negative reactions with beauty products but unfortunately with the Roc I did. I applied to clean dry skin on my forehead area after a shower at night. When I woke up the next morning my skin on my forehead was peeling. I don't think I will use this product again for fear of what concerns I have from that.

Works initially. Great creamy texture. Absorbed well. By the end of the day was rubbing of like dead skin and sweat. Really off putting. I do not wear foundation, so this may be why. I did receive this as a free trial.

I received the Roc Derm Correxion Fill & Treat Serum with Advanced Retinol & Triple Hyaluronic Acid product for free from Roc & PINCHme in exchange for my honest opinion. This product is successful with diminishing fine lines and wrinkles. Swertiamarin repairs the epidermis, and the three forms of hyaluronic acid seem to prevent the retinol from being too irritating to your skin or drying it out. Depending on your skin, you may need to space out the use. Don't forget to apply at least an 15 SPF during the day. This is dermatologist tested, paraben-free, non-comedogenic, and fragrance-free. This was not irritating to my sensitive skin. It diminished the appearance of the fine lines in between my brows and laugh lines. My marionette lines appeared minimized and smoother. It's a winner in my book that I have added to my favorites. Thank you, Roc & PINCHme.

I was able to try RoC Derm Correxion Fill + Treat Serum from PinchMe for free in exchange for a honest review. I usually put this on in the morning before I apply any other makeup to have it absorb into my skin as much as possible before I put on moisture and sunscreen. It absorbs really well on all my skin that I applied it on - forehead lines, crow's feet, in-between the eyes, and neck lines. I have been using it very consistently for 6 weeks but have not seen much improvement in any of the areas.

extraits.titre: RoC Derm Correxion Fill + Treat Serum is Dazzling
extraits.texte: I received this product as a free sample through PinchME.com and I have to say that I'm quite impressed. This product was comfortable on my skin since the first day I tried it. It works great for my dry to extremely dry facial skin. I haven't experienced any breakouts or any reactions of any kind. I use this product consistently in my morning skincare routine. As time goes on, I have noticed my smile and forehead lines becoming less pronounced.

RoC Derm Correxion Fill + Treat Serum is a game changer for those suffering from visible signs of aging, including fine lines and wrinkles. This thick and creamy serum is the perfect texture and absorbs easily, without leaving skin feeling greasy. I have been using it for a few weeks now and I have noticed significant change in my deeper laugh lines and crows feet. My surface wrinkles are less visible and skin is overall more hydrated. I have been using it daily at night and my skin feels smoother and plump by the morning. A little goes a long way!
This product did not do a thing for me. It's expensive for what it is as well. Big box with a tiny tube inside.
